belfort.name: Belfry of Bruges
belfort.slogan: 366 steps up to the bells that have timed the Markt since 1240.
belfort.line: In the market-place of Bruges stands the belfry old and brown; Thrice consumed and thrice rebuilded, still it watches o'er the town.
belfort.by: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, The Belfry of Bruges, 1845

rozenhoedkaai.name: Rozenhoedkaai
rozenhoedkaai.slogan: Gabled houses, still water and the Belfry doubled in the canal.
rozenhoedkaai.line: A jetty here once unloaded the ships that brought salt to Bruges.

begijnhof.name: Begijnhof
begijnhof.slogan: White gables around a lawn of daffodils, and not a sound.
begijnhof.line: The beguinage was founded around 1244 by Margaret of Constantinople, Countess of Flanders.

madonna.name: Madonna of Bruges
madonna.slogan: Michelangelo's marble mother, calm in a Flemish church.
madonna.line: Carved around 1504, it was the first Michelangelo sculpture to leave Italy in his lifetime; Nazi troops took it in 1944 and it was found in an Austrian salt mine.

molens.name: Windmills of the Kruisvest
molens.slogan: Four mills still turn on the green ramparts above the old moat.
molens.line: The Sint-Janshuismolen of 1770 still stands on its original site and is the only rampart mill that still grinds grain.
